'Amar Ekushey' sculpture in bad shape
2016-02-03T00:00:00+06:00 | Md. Asaduz Zaman, Department of Economics, Jahangirnagar University
https://www.thedailystar.net/letters/amar-ekushey-sculpture-bad-shape-211699

It is very sad that the historic 'Amar Ekushey' sculpture of JU has been in a poor condition for years. Parts of this great piece of work have already fallen apart exposing rusty iron rods. The colour of the sculpture has also faded. But the university authority is paying no attention to this.

We want to draw the attention of the university authority so that they take effective measures to repair it as soon as possible.
